summary:
**Conversation Overview**

The person is associated with The Luxora Collective, a B2B growth consultancy that works with independent medspa owners. They identified themselves as connected to a co-founder and CEO named Bethany Anne. The task was to draft a professional outreach email to Bob Thomas, owner of NexGen Wellness, a peptide company. The introduction to Bob came via a mutual contact named Sandra Cook.

The email's purpose was to explore whether NexGen Wellness partners with medspas to supply peptides directly to patients on behalf of practices that don't fulfill them in-house, while allowing the medspa to include peptides in their service packages and earn a commission. The person also wanted to inquire about the client onboarding process, any revenue-sharing or referral structures, and importantly, how NexGen Wellness handles medical guidance and compliance — specifically whether they offer advisory support to medspa owners on appropriate peptide recommendations and any direct consultation available to patients. The compliance and ethical dimensions of this inquiry were explicitly flagged as a priority alongside the commercial structure.

Claude drafted a complete outreach email with a subject line referencing Sandra Cook's referral, an intro about The Luxora Collective and its medspa clientele, and a structured set of bullet-point questions covering partnership feasibility, onboarding process, commission structure, product guidance, and patient support. The email maintained a warm but professional tone and closed with a request for a 20–30 minute introductory call. Claude also noted that the sign-off could be adjusted if a different team member was sending the email, and offered to draft a follow-up version for non-responses.

variants.body:
Hi Bob,

My name is Bethany Anne, and I'm the Co-Founder and CEO of The Luxora Collective, a B2B growth consultancy based in Tennessee. Sandra Cook passed along your information and thought it would be worth connecting, so I wanted to reach out directly.

A quick bit of context: at The Luxora Collective, we work exclusively with independent medspa owners generating between $500K and $3M annually. Our 90-Day Growth Engine helps them install membership programs, upsell frameworks, package architecture, and marketing systems that increase client retention and revenue. In short, we sit inside the day-to-day business strategy of medspa owners and help them grow in a way that's sustainable and client-centered.

The reason I wanted to connect with you is that several of our clients have expressed interest in offering peptides to their patients, but they either don't currently carry them or aren't set up to fulfill them directly. I'd love to explore whether NexGen Wellness has a partnership or referral structure that would allow our medspa clients to include peptides in their service packages and offer them to patients, with fulfillment handled on your end.

A few things I'd love to learn more about:

- Does NexGen Wellness partner with medspas to help them offer peptides to their patients, even if the spa doesn't dispense them directly?
- What does the process look like for getting a medspa client set up with your company?
- Is there a commission or revenue-sharing structure available for the referring practice?
- Does your team provide any guidance to medspa owners on which peptides may be appropriate to recommend to their patient base, and how that works from an ethical and legal standpoint?
- Is there any level of medical consultation or advisory support available to the patient once they're connected with NexGen Wellness?

The vision I have is pretty simple: our clients get to elevate their offering and keep their patients engaged and happy, their patients get access to quality peptide products through a trusted source, and everyone benefits from a clean referral relationship. I want to make sure we do this the right way, which is why understanding the compliance and guidance side of things is just as important to me as the commercial structure.

I'd love to set up a short call to learn more about how NexGen Wellness operates and see if there's a natural fit here. Would you have 20-30 minutes in the next week or two?

Thank you, Bob. Looking forward to connecting.

Warm regards,
Bethany Anne
Co-Founder & CEO, The Luxora Collective
